name: CRM - Customer Health Dashboard
description: Theo dõi sức khỏe khách hàng: satisfaction score, churn risk, retention rate

native.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 2) as avg_score FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.crm_surveys WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

SELECT c.name, MAX(s.created_at) as last_survey, ROUND(AVG(s.score), 2) as avg_score FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.crm_customers c JOIN {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.crm_surveys s ON c.id = s.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING AVG(s.score) < 3 ORDER BY avg_score ASC LIMIT 15
SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) as week, status, COUNT(*) as count FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.crm_tickets WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY week, status ORDER BY week
